name: Triggered & Delayed Instruction Activation
description: An injected instruction that stays dormant until a condition is met — a keyword, a later turn, a specific tool result or a time/step delay — so the payload is not present in the request that eventually causes the action.
differs: Distinguished from Direct/Indirect Prompt Injection (T1.001/T1.002) by the activation model: the ingress and the influence are separated in time, which breaks single-turn detection and complicates trace correlation.
